title: Nell Finds a Big Job
note: b418 — Phase 5 complete (School readiness) — Phonics Screening Check review week.

pages.brief: Nell the bee hovering above a narrow garden stream, looking at a thick brown branch lying across it.
Water pooling up behind a thick brown branch lying across a narrow garden stream.
Nell the bee pressing against a thick brown branch with her front legs, the branch staying still.
Nell the bee resting on top of a thick brown branch, looking tired, the stream still blocked.
Nell the bee calling out towards Pip the sparrow and Moss the hedgehog in the distance.
Pip the sparrow and Moss the hedgehog arriving at the edge of a narrow garden stream.
Nell the bee, Pip the sparrow and Moss the hedgehog all pushing against a thick brown branch together from different sides.
A thick brown branch sliding away from a narrow garden stream, water beginning to flow past it.
A narrow garden stream flowing freely and quickly now that a branch is clear of it.
Nell the bee, Pip the sparrow and Moss the hedgehog standing together by a clear, flowing stream, all looking pleased.
